ns2:course.label: Earth's Physical Systems
ns2:course.description: A basic introduction to the environmental systems of the Earth's surface, including landforms, soils, and ecosystems and how these systems are affected by global change. Emphasizes the importance of human-Earth relations and a holistic view of environmental systems. Same as ESE 103.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for the lecture and one lab-discussion section.
